members.description: A traveling arcanist who rides with the troupe. Speaks in riddles and watches the world with patient eyes.
Kvothe's father. Leader of the Edema Ruh troupe, composing a song he will not finish.
Kvothe's mother. A baron's daughter by birth, a trouper by choice, and sharper than either lets on.
Practical, sharp-tongued, and rarely without a scrap of leather to mend. Keeps the wagons stocked and the hides curing.
Cheerful, restless, and handy with a brace and bit. Knows every squeak and groan of the troupe's wagons.
